items.description:
One Bulk operation. `method`+`path` identify the per-user verb
(`POST /scim/v2/Users`, `PUT/PATCH/DELETE /scim/v2/Users/{id}`),
`bulkId` correlates a create response back to the caller's batch
entries, `data` is the operation's request body.

bulk_id.description: Caller-supplied correlation id (echoed in the response entry).

method.description: The HTTP verb of the wrapped per-user operation.

items.title: ScimBulkOperation

failOnErrors.description: Max failures before the batch stops (RFC 7644 §3.7). 0 = unlimited.
